H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H516: 'Thou must not destroy'; probably the opening words to a popular song
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H1272: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H7586: Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H3671: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H1942: by implication, of falling); desire; also ruin
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H5945: an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H1584: to end (in the sense of completion or failure)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H2778: to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter
H7602: to inhale eagerly; figuratively, to cover; by implication, to be angry; also to hasten
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H3833: to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;))
H7901: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
H3857: properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H2595: a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent)
H2671: properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H2719: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness

H6471: a stroke, literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow)
H3738: properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H5035: a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form)
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H7834: a powder (as beaten small); by analogy, a thin vapor; by extension, the firmament
